pattern.name: advice-before-understanding
pattern.description: Gives a suggestion in its first reply without asking about the person's circumstances.

sources.technique: Ask one open question and reflect the answer before any suggestion.

earlier_edits.summary: Limit replies to one or two sentences.
Offer one small suggestion and ask whether it fits.
